title: Checks for mixed tabs and spaces in indentation.
summary: Never mix tabs and spaces. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle and made it stable in v0.0.229.
message_templates: Indentation contains mixed spaces and tabs

title: Checks for indentation with a non-multiple of 4 spaces.
summary: According to PEP 8, 4 spaces per indentation level should be preferred. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle. It is in preview.
message_templates: Indentation is not a multiple of {}

title: Checks for indented blocks that are lacking indentation.
summary: All indented blocks should be indented; otherwise, they are not valid Python syntax. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle. It is in preview.

title: Checks for unexpected indentation.
summary: Indentation outside of a code block is not valid Python syntax. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle. It is in preview.

title: Checks for indentation of comments with a non-multiple of 4 spaces.
summary: According to PEP 8, 4 spaces per indentation level should be preferred. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle. It is in preview.
message_templates: Indentation is not a multiple of {} (comment)

title: Checks for comments in a code blocks that are lacking indentation.
summary: Comments within an indented block should themselves be indented, to indicate that they are part of the block. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle. It is in preview.

title: Checks for unexpected indentation of comment.
summary: Comments should match the indentation of the containing code block. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle. It is in preview.

title: Checks for over-indented code.
summary: According to PEP 8, 4 spaces per indentation level should be preferred. Increased indentation can lead to inconsistent formatting, which can hurt readability. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle. It is in preview.
